title: The frame shop, empty, 2021
logline: The frame shop's storefront in March 2021, empty, a FOR LEASE card, the transom, and in the window's reflection nothing — the Absent rule applied to a reflection. Ten years since the last mat.

panels.composition: An empty storefront with a paper card taped inside the door's glass, an old transom above, the window reflecting only the gray street with no one in it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an empty small-town storefront with a paper card taped inside the door's glass and an old transom above, the window reflecting a gray street with no one in it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
